author: piztanza
description: Implement the Indonesia flyover map (F-006): near-1:1 port of .ba/discovery/design-reference/indo-globe.js into src/components/three/IndoGlobe.tsx (client-only, three from npm) — dot-matrix archipelago, Jakarta marker + pulse ring + translated label, animated arcs to 6 cities, idle drift + clamped drag panning — wired into the Unify band's 1.9:1 container with lazy loading and WebGL fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Archipelago geometry matches the design reference (ISLANDS polygons, 0.27° dot fill with jittered two-tone layers + pseudo-elevation, ocean grid, fog + radial fade)
Jakarta marker with pulsing ring and projected label; label text translates live with the lang prop ('— first market, 2026' / '— pasar pertama, 2026')
Six quadratic-bezier arcs with moving additive dots animate toward the cities; static prop freezes dots mid-arc and steadies the ring
Idle camera drifts west↔east and reverses at bounds; pointer drag pans within clamps with grab/grabbing cursor; drift resumes after 3s idle; IntersectionObserver re-centers on entry
Rendered at 1.9:1 in the Unify band replacing the placeholder, with the drag-hint caption below
three code-split (next/dynamic ssr:false), init on approach, clean unmount disposal; dark gradient fallback without WebGL
Suite stays green; new unit tests cover the point-in-polygon fill and label translation
